steps: Toast shredded pastry until golden and crisp.
Mix toasted pastry with rich pistachio cream.
Chill mixture to firm up for shaping.
Melt marshmallow base with cocoa powder on stovetop.
Dip chilled filling balls into the warm mixture.
Place coated items on a lined tray.
Refrigerate until the shell sets firm.

swaps.why: Oven not available; fridge sets marshmallow coating effectively

hooks: Sweet treat for your Kopi break.
plan.caption: New on the menu! Our Dubai-style chewy cookie brings that satisfying crunch and chew. A marshmallow-cocoa shell wraps around sweet pistachio kataifi. Perfect with your Teh Tarik or Milo. Come try it today at Ah Seng Drinks Stall! #SingaporeFood #AhSengDrinks
